why: What the AI reads homework texts as: whether the whole class has something to do, and which sentences are only for pupils who missed the lesson. Made up after the wordings a real class's homework uses, many of which the fallback words miss: 'Ei läksyä' in the middle of a text, a lesson described with no task, other forms of 'poissaolleet', 'jos olit pois', the pupils who were away first and the class second, and only instructions for those who were away.

items.subject: Äidinkieli
items.text: Tunnilla harjoiteltiin yhdyssanoja pareittain. Ei läksyä tänään. Hyvää viikonloppua!

items.subject: Biologia
items.text:

items.text: Kertaa sanasto kappaleista 1–3, koe on maanantaina. Jos olit tänään pois, tee Classroomissa kertausharjoitus.
